documentInfo.participation: Justice Jackson delivered the opinion of the Court in Parts I, II, III, IV-A and IV-B, joined by all eight other Justices. Chief Justice Roberts and Justices Sotomayor and Kagan also joined Part IV-C, a plurality opinion.
